scope: Union of saved worst-setup-path connections, matched packed/place/architecture/netlist/RRG. Unique sink-cluster location plus identical source/sink RR; not a certified atom-pin mapping. Physical audited RR delay is not full STA delay. Direct and any-net final guides distinguish possible indirect effects, not single-event causality or earlier guide history. Unsealed batches are exploratory diagnostics, excluded from quality aggregates.
